_help: Maps a CATEGORY from the TAG: line of an MCQ to the Main > Sub > Minor tree. Keys are case-insensitive. 'main' = letter A-H (required). 'sub' = exact subtopic name from topics.json (optional - if left out, a single-subtopic topic uses its only subtopic, otherwise 'General'). 'minor' is optional (defaults to the category text itself, so it shows up as its own chip). Categories NOT listed here are auto-matched against names in topics.json; anything still unmatched goes to 'Other / Unsorted' and the converter prints a warning naming it.
